omits-cluster-inhibition-identity.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: owned
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - case
  group_wait: 100ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1h
receivers:
- name: owned
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/owned
    send_resolved: true
inhibit_rules:
- source_matchers:
  - alertname="InfraDown"
  - severity="critical"
  target_matchers:
  - alertname="DependentSymptom"
  - severity="warning"
  equal:
  - service
